name: gtdb_ssu
title: GTDB R232 16S rRNA of species representatives
description: 16S rRNA genes of GTDB R232 species-representative genomes (Bacteria + Archaea) with GTDB taxonomy, unfiltered. Some representative genomes carry contaminating 16S genes and GTDB splits many genera (e.g. Enterococcus, Enterococcus_C), so expect more reads to stop above genus than with RefSeq 16S.
